payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about the pruning process used in the KDG model, including its impact on model performance and the method of eliminating spurious logical forms.

claims.text: The KDG model performed pruning of spurious logical forms using an algorithm that filters out logical forms failing to provide correct answers on fictitious tables.
Without the pruning step, the accuracy of the KDG model dropped significantly from 43.3% to 36.3%.
The pruning algorithm eliminated 92.1% of spurious logical forms, enhancing the training data quality for the KDG model.
